CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION company_checkout_allowance_private.report_basis(rid uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select jsonb_build_object('header',jsonb_build_object('company_id',r.company_id,'site_id',r.site_id,
  'route_assignment_id',r.route_assignment_id,'report_date',r.report_date,'work_description',r.work_description),
  'workers',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('worker_id',w.worker_id,'overtime_hours',w.overtime_hours,
   'early_hours',w.early_hours,'night_hours',w.night_hours,'allowance_amount',w.allowance_amount,
   'allowance_label',w.allowance_label,'work_category',w.work_category,'company_allowance_selections',w.company_allowance_selections)
   order by w.worker_id),'[]'::jsonb) from public.daily_report_workers w where w.report_id=rid))
 from public.daily_reports r where r.id=rid
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION company_checkout_allowance_private.resolve(cid uuid, wid uuid, p_start date, p_end date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare receipts jsonb; answer jsonb;
begin
 if p_start is null or p_end is null or p_start<>date_trunc('month',p_start)::date
 or p_end<>(p_start+interval '1 month - 1 day')::date then raise exception 'canonical payroll month required' using errcode='22023';end if;
 if exists(select 1 from public.attendance_entries a left join company_checkout_allowance_private.receipts r
 on r.id=a.company_allowance_receipt_id and r.company_id=a.company_id and r.worker_id=a.worker_id
 and r.work_date=a.work_date and r.report_id=a.source_report_id
 where a.company_id=cid and a.worker_id=wid and a.work_date between p_start and p_end
 and a.company_allowance_receipt_id is not null and r.id is null) then
  return jsonb_build_object('items','[]'::jsonb,'earnings','[]'::jsonb,'deductions','[]'::jsonb,'blocked',true,
   'reasons',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('code','company_receipt_scope_mismatch')));end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(r.snapshot order by a.work_date,r.id),'[]') into receipts
 from public.attendance_entries a join company_checkout_allowance_private.receipts r
 on r.id=a.company_allowance_receipt_id and r.company_id=a.company_id and r.worker_id=a.worker_id
 and r.work_date=a.work_date and r.report_id=a.source_report_id
 where a.company_id=cid and a.worker_id=wid and a.work_date between p_start and p_end
 and a.work_date<=(current_timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Tokyo')::date;
 answer:=company_checkout_allowance_private.aggregate(receipts);
 return answer;
end $function$
